field_key.farm.prospects: [key, name, pos, age, consensus_fv, efv, acq_method, acq_year, pick_overall, bonus_usd, slot_usd, cur_method, cur_year, surplus_mm, band_lo_mm, band_hi_mm, p_bust, net_mm, dollar_dvm_plus, eta_year, service_phase, on_40_man, options_left, rule5_exposed, tv_grade, cons_surplus_mm, cons_lo_mm, cons_hi_mm]; surplus_mm is the eFV expected surplus (trade board trade_value_mm, equal to the eFV export's surplus_mm); band_lo/hi are the row's p10/p90 on that basis and are never summed; net_mm = surplus_mm - bonus_usd / 1e6 and is the only column the leaf sums; cons_* are the PROSPX consensus-basis figures for the expander only
field_key.farm.graduates: [key, name, pos, debut_date, acq_method, acq_year, bonus_usd, dv_trade_value_mm, dv_realized_mm, control_thru, control_why, tv_trade_value_mm, tv_surplus_source, service_phase, career_war, wag_label, in_vets, dev_share, now_with]. The dv_* columns come from debuts_lite debuted_value (debuted_player_value) and the tv_* columns from the trade board: two engines on one row, each labelled, never summed. The control_thru/control_why pair is the current control window from the trade board's debuted row, else the /projections/ vet row, else null (never the at-debut window). The in_vets flag says whether /projections/ carries the player. The dev_share column is the club's development share of the graduate (dev_attribution: acquisition value to the signing club, each club's grade growth while it held him), so a club lists every graduate it developed, including one now elsewhere. The now_with column is the club he is with today, null outside the 30.
field_key.farm.picks: year -> [[pick_overall, round_label, player_name, slot_usd, bonus_usd, signed, over_slot_usd, prospect_key]]; over_slot_usd is bonus minus slot only when both are non-zero (the draft_paid slotted rule), else null: an unsigned pick is not an under-slot saving; prospect_key is the farm.prospects row when the pick is still an active prospect of this club, else null
field_key.arbitration.ladders: [name, mlbam, sv, svy, class, flags, years_left, ladder [[season, proj_usd, lo_usd, hi_usd, token]], war [projected WAR per rung on the fWAR label basis, aligned], tot_usd, in_vets, has_salpath]; lo/hi are a fixed-spread band (0.22 + 0.08 per rung) and not P10/P90; sv is a string and prints as is; svy is the season the string is as of; no filing figure, hearing flag or comp exists on any row
field_key.arbitration.realized.rows: [season, mlbam, name, arb_year, actual_usd, ours_usd, swartz_usd, ou_mkt_usd, ou_war_usd, war, flags]; the arb_history row minus its team; swartz_usd is the MLB Trade Rumors (Matt Swartz) published pre-settlement projection, present on some rows; ou_mkt and ou_war are never combined and swartz is neither
field_key.contracts.paths: [key, war[5], war_p10[5], war_p90[5], sur_mm[5], sur_npv_usd, sur_ros_mm, sur_total_usd, tv_mm, tv_lo_mm, tv_hi_mm, tv_grade, surplus_source, band_basis, salary_basis, control_thru, control_why, remaining_control_years, player_opt_years, club_opt_years, reanchored, npv_check_usd, club_opt_declined]; war and sur are per-season expected values (MLB Projections); war_p10/p90 and tv_lo/hi print per row and are never summed; sur_npv_usd equals the contract row's; reanchored is true when tv_mm differs from sur_total_usd / 1e6 by more than 0.06 on a projection-sourced row; npv_check_usd is the NPV of the published strip at the platform rate, printed beside sur_npv_usd as an identity check; club_opt_declined lists the club option seasons the club would decline on the mean path, each priced at $0 in sur_mm
field_key.surplus.rows_debuted: [key, name, pos, tv_mm, tv_lo_mm, tv_hi_mm, tv_tier, tv_grade, surplus_source, salary_basis, control_thru, control_why, in_contract_rows]; the trade board's debuted rows for the club; active rows are the farm ledger's prospect rows and are not repeated
field_key.farm.prospect_trajectory: key -> [[snapshot_date, trade_value_mm]] for the preview keys only (shard; the board's preview rows draw it once the shard is in)
field_key.surplus.trajectory: [snapshot_date, trade_value_mm sum] over every row of the club on that snapshot (shard, moved off the board 2026-09-30)
field_key.farm.trajectory_active: [snapshot_date, sum of trade_value_mm over that snapshot's active-status rows]; each snapshot's own actives, gross eFV basis, no bonus netting, so it is not the leaf's series (shard, moved off the board 2026-09-30)
field_key.payroll.history: [season, tax_payroll_usd, payor_tier, threshold_usd, over_threshold_usd, est_tax_bill_usd, total_payroll_usd]; one row per season the cached Spotrac tax page carries the club, read without a fetch (fa_sources.read_cached_payroll_history); threshold_usd is that season's threshold as its own page prints it; over_threshold_usd = tax_payroll_usd - threshold_usd (negative = under); est_tax_bill_usd is Spotrac's estimate, blank, never zero, where the page shows none; total_payroll_usd is Spotrac total payroll allocations off the season's payroll page (null where none is cached); realized figures, not a forecast
field_key.fa.profile: {share {recent|all: [usd, share, rank]}, bands {recent|all: [[n_deals, guar_usd] per band in league.fa_spend_profile.bands order]}, resign {recent|all: [n_departed, n_resigned, share]}, qo {recent|all: [qo_in, qo_out]}, n_milb_in {recent|all: n}}; usd is the sum of the club's Spend by winter cells (fa.winters spend_in_usd) over the window, share is usd over the thirty clubs' total for the window, rank 1 the largest; bands, departures and re-signings count major-league deals only; realized spending, not a forecast
